Guaraci - SP

title: Especialista em melhoria contínua
description:
Nosso sucesso é fruto da dedicação e do talento das pessoas que trabalham conosco. Construímos uma cultura forte, baseada em valores sólidos, que guiam nossas decisões, estratégias e a busca por profissionais alinhados ao nosso propósito.


Acreditamos que desafios são oportunidades e buscamos talentos que compartilhem de nossos valores, contribuindo para um ambiente dinâmico e inspirador.


Juntos, seguimos aprimorando nossa cultura e fortalecendo nosso compromisso de alimentar sua vida.


Você será responsável por:



  • Realizar análises detalhadas dos processos existentes, identificando áreas de melhoria e ineficiências.
  • Implementar plano mestre da em empresa através das ferramentas de Melhoria Contínua e auxiliar a gestão na implantação e execução dos processos.
  • Realizar direcionamento para que ocorra o desempenho nos principais pilares da organização, segurança, qualidade e produtividade e gestão de perdas através da identificação e desenvolvimento de planos de ação estratégicos.
  • Criar e gerenciar iniciativas de performance entre unidades, visando redução de perdas, treinamentos, compartilhamento de melhores práticas e aplicação de ferramentas metodológicas.
  • Elaborar e implementar planos de ação para otimizar processos, reduzir custos e melhorar a qualidade.
  • Coordenar e gerenciar projetos de melhoria contínua, garantindo a entrega no prazo e dentro do orçamento.
  • Aplicar metodologias de melhoria contínua, como Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, entre outras, para alcançar resultados sustentáveis.
  • Fornecer treinamento e suporte às equipes sobre práticas de melhoria contínua e ferramentas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos processos após a implementação de melhorias, avaliando a eficácia e ajustando conforme necessário.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de progresso e resultados das iniciativas de melhoria para a liderança e partes interessadas.
  • Buscar constantemente novas oportunidades e melhores práticas para promover uma cultura de inovação e melhoria contínua.


O que a Vigor espera:


  • Graduação Completa em Engenharia, Administração, Qualidade, ou áreas relacionadas. Pós-graduação ou certificações em metodologias de melhoria contínua (como Lean Six Sigma) são um diferencial.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de melhoria contínua, preferencialmente em (setor específico, se aplicável).
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Proficiência em ferramentas e metodologias de melhoria contínua, como Lean, Six Sigma, e análise de dados.
  • Ter atuado na área de Melhoria Contínua em Manufatura enxuta (LEAN), com gerenciamento de processos e programas.
  • Planejamento estratégico, atuação em planos de negócios.
  • Conhecimento em análises de falhas e ferramentas de melhorias para soluções de problemas: Ver e agir, 5PQ's, Diagrama de Ishikawa, PDCA.
  • Conhecimento com a gestão de indicadores, e diagnósticos através de dados, desenho e execução de plano de ação.


Regime de Contratação: 100% presencial, atuação São Gonçalo do Sapucaí - MG

title: Executivo Comercial - Nova Friburgo
description:
Líder Mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países através de uma rede de 5.500 delegações, que proporcionam diariamente emprego a 700.000 pessoas e presta serviço a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da lista 500 da Fortune Global e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique.


A Adecco apresenta uma estrutura mundial orientada para a prestação de um serviço integrado na área dos Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de um desenvolvimento contínuo de soluções eficazes e competitivas para os seus clientes.


Procuramos profissionais engajados, com foco em resultados e experiência no ambiente comercial para atuar como Executivo(a) de Negócios.


Requisitos:

Ensino superior completo em Comunicação Social, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia em departamentos comerciais ou áreas relacionadas em empresas privadas.

Conhecimento em processos comerciais, CRM e Pacote Office.

Diferencial experiência com mídia técnica e gestão de carteira.


Oportunidades exclusiva para NOVA FRIBURGO.

title: Coordenadora de RH
description:
Verallia, um excelente lugar para desenvolver seu potencial e contribuir para um mundo sustentável!


A Verallia é a empresa líder na Europa na indústria e a terceira maior produtora de vidro do mundo, fornecendo embalagens de vidro de qualidade excepcional aos seus clientes há mais de duzentos anos.

Uma carreira na Verallia não é apenas um emprego, mas um caminho que oferece oportunidades para causar um impacto substancial neste setor emocionante e no mundo.


Estamos buscando COORDENADORA DE RH para se juntar à nossa equipe de Recursos Humanos, em nossa fábrica em PORTO FERREIRA . Esta vaga é afirmativa para mulheres.

Estamos em busca de uma profissional estratégica, com forte capacidade de liderança e visão sistêmica, para coordenar as principais frentes de RH em nossa unidade industrial. Esta posição é chave para garantir a conexão entre pessoas, processos e resultados.


As principais responsabilidades do cargo serão:

  • Liderar os processos de recrutamento e seleção, assegurando a atração de talentos alinhados à cultura e às necessidades do negócio.
  • Planejar e implementar programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento.
  • Gerenciar a comunicação interna, promovendo transparência e engajamento em torno das políticas, indicadores e iniciativas corporativas.
  • Analisar e validar movimentações de cargos e salários, garantindo equidade, conformidade orçamentária e valorização dos colaboradores.
  • Conduzir pesquisas de clima organizacional e liderar planos de ação voltados à melhoria contínua do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Atuar junto à gerência de fábrica na definição de metas para as chefias, preparando os cálculos conforme atingimento dos objetivos, para pagamento de bônus.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento de RH e mão de obra.
  • Supervisionar programas de segurança patrimonial e saúde ocupacional, assegurando conformidade legal e bem-estar dos colaboradores.
  • Organizar eventos internos e campanhas corporativas, fortalecendo a cultura e o senso de pertencimento.
  • Coordenar o processo de fechamento de diretrizes do PRE, promovendo reuniões de negociações, junto ao sindicato e comissão interna, para definição de metas da unidade (segurança, rendimento, produtividade, avarias etc.)
  • Supervisionar os serviços de manutenção das instalações, como segurança patrimonial, portaria e limpeza da planta, garantindo a integridade das instalações, conformidade com normas internas e externas, e um ambiente seguro e organizado para todos os colaboradores.


Requisitos para a vaga:

Formação acadêmica: Superior completo Administração, Psicologia, Direito ou correlatos;

Conhecimentos específicos: Ampla experiencia na área de Recursos Humanos: Cargos e Salários, Relações Trabalhistas e Sindicais, Negociação e Liderança. Treinamento na documentação SIG aplicável à função.

Habilidades interpessoais: Liderança colaborativa, orientação a resultados, gestão da comunicação e cultura organizacional, tomada de decisão com base em dados, trabalho em equipe, iniciativa e proatividade.

Desejável: Inglês


Venha trabalhar conosco e faça parte desta grande equipe.

Nossa paixão é o vidro, nossa inspiração é você!

title: Financial Analyst
description:
This is a dynamic role that involves navigating through various responsibilities within the Finance department. The ideal candidate should be able to cover for employees during vacation periods and maternity leave, and eventually, by mid-next year, assume a Finance Analyst role responsible for Sales Invoices and Accounts Payable.

We are looking for someone willing to lead and execute a project to automate our accounts payable process by implementing CNAB file usage (the system already supports this functionality). During this transition period, the candidate will gain experience across different areas of the Finance organization, which will strengthen their knowledge and prepare them to take on the main responsibilities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Receive daily picking lists from Logistics, insert selected serial numbers into the system, verify item balances and weight distribution, and input transportation and other outbound data.
  • Register invoices with the government, issue them to customers, and send product quality certificates.
  • Create various invoice types: consignments, alternate delivery addresses, industrialization, branch transfers, and exports.
  • Weekly, handle fiscal appointments related to issued invoices, including customer communication and issuing correction letters or other adjustments.
  • Compare weekly DDA-bank data with system records to ensure all open items are posted and approved.
  • Generate and send one weekly payment file to the bank, process the return file, and reconcile posted amounts.
  • Twice a month, organize intercompany international payments, perform cash flow analysis, gather documentation, send to the bank, and register payments.
  • Support month-end closing by reconciling accounts such as stock, intercompany payables, and imports in transit.


Required:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Accountant or other related areas.
  • Advanced English.
  • Excel skills.
  • Knowledge of accounts payable, invoicing, or accounting processes.


Desirable:

  • Experience working with SAP B1.
  • Speak Spanish (intermediate level).
  • Experience working with CNAB files.

Missão do cargo:

Realizar visitas aos clientes de médio e pequeno porte, dentro de sua área de atuação, negociações de descontos e pedidos de vendas, bem como reposição de nossos produtos. Respeitar a frequência e sequência de visita aos clientes, conforme itinerário pré-estabelecido pela empresa.


Principais atividades:

• Realizar visita aos clientes seguindo a frequência e sequência estabelecida pela Cia, bem como negociação de descontos escalonados ou bonificados, pedidos de venda, reposição/organização das gôndolas de toda nossa linha de produtos de acordo com o planograma pré-estabelecido pela empresa, revisão das datas dos produtos, exibições, limpeza, precificação, FIFO e retirada de produtos para devolução/recuperação de acordo com as normas Bimbo;

• Retirar da área de venda qualquer produto que não cumpra com o processo de frescor, tabela de retirada impressas no produto, produtos rasgados, amassados, descaracterizados ou com aspecto/aparência imprópria e encaminhar a área de troca para ser destinado a devolução/recuperação;

• Negociar junto aos clientes buscando pontos de melhoria e oportunidades de incrementar suas vendas e dessa forma atingir as metas e objetivos estabelecidos pela gerência/supervisão;

• Realizar trabalhos de merchandising de todo mix de produtos da empresa, bem como acompanhar as degustações e ações promocionais;

• Trabalhar para obter o crescimento das vendas de suas lojas;

title: Engenheiro DEVOPS
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital.

Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: CONSULTOR DEVOPS


Responsabilidades e atribuições

-Projetar e manter pipelines CI/CD robustos com validações automatizadas (unit, integration e security tests), aplicando práticas de GitFlow ou trunk-based development.

-Automatizar provisionamento de ambientes cloud (IaaS/PaaS) com Terraform, CloudFormation ou scripts personalizados.

-Realizar o versionamento e governança de infraestrutura como código, garantindo rastreabilidade e auditoria de mudanças.

-Integrar ferramentas de segurança ao pipeline (DevSecOps), como SonarQube, Veracode, assegurando o shift-left na análise de vulnerabilidades.

-Operar e otimizar ambientes de execução em containers (Docker) e orquestração (ECS).

-Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento para padronizar repositórios, criar templates de pipeline e boas práticas DevOps.

-Escrever e manter documentações técnicas sobre fluxos CI/CD, provisionamento e governança de ambientes.

Requisitos e qualificações

-Experiência em Azure DevOps.

-AWS (Cloud Formation, Lambda, etc).

-Provisionamento de Infraestrutura como código (IaC).

-TFS (Team Foundation Server).

-Gestão de Configuração e Mudança.

-Ferramentas de versionamento (Git; Subversion/TFVC se necessário para legados).

-Docker/containers.

-Ferramentas de análise de código e segurança (SonarQube e Veracode).

-Ferramentas de repositórios e dependências (Nexus).

-Automação em geral (scripts Python, PowerShell e Bash).

-Criação de scripts com chamadas de API e montagem de pacotes.

-Linguagens de programação Plataforma Microsoft (C#, Angular, .NET Core, VB.net)


CLT

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) designer de Produto/ desenvolvimento de produto (louças e metais) para integrar nosso time!


Local: Gramado - RS

Tipo de vaga: Presencial


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um designer de Produto/ desenvolvimento de produto (louças e metais) e Responsável por planejar, desenvolver e acompanhar o portfólio de produtos de louças e metais sanitários, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia da marca, demandas do mercado e viabilidade técnica e comercial. Atua desde a concepção até o pós-lançamento, conectando design, engenharia, produção e marketing.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Pesquisa & Planejamento

  • Realizar pesquisa de tendências, concorrência e benchmarks nacionais e internacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de novos produtos e melhorias de linha;
  • Apoiar na definição do portfólio estratégico


2. Desenvolvimento de Produto

  • Elaborar briefings detalhados para novos produtos (design, dimensões, acabamentos, funcionalidades);
  • Acompanhar a criação de protótipos e moldes junto às áreas técnicas e fornecedores;
  • Validar desenhos técnicos, normas de desempenho (ex: ABNT/NBR, ISO), ergonomia e funcionamento hidráulico;


3. Gestão de Linha

  • Acompanhar ciclo de vida dos produtos: lançamento, maturidade, renovação e descontinuação;
  • Monitorar performance da linha (mix, rentabilidade, giro, margem, feedback comercial);
  • Propor ajustes no portfólio e novas soluções por faixa de preço ou aplicação


4. Interface com Áreas Internas

  • Apoiar a área de marketing com especificações técnicas, comparativos e argumentos de venda;


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Design de Produto ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de produtos industriais ou acabamentos;
  • Vivência com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais (especialmente China/Ásia);
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Head of Medical Aesthetics Sales
description:
PLEASE CAN I ASK FOR AN ENGLISH CV WHEN YOU APPLY?


*** we are NOT looking to hire you as an employee - rather to work with you as a consultant -


*** we will need you to come from the medical aesthetics industry, ideally from one of the big companies like Allergen, Galderma, Mertz, Rennova etc...


*** you will have a large network of healthcare clinics, Aesthetic GPs, Cosmetic & Plastic surgeons, Dentists (who use dermal fillers and Botox related products), and Dermatologists in Brazil - and you will be used to selling to them


** you will need to have fluency in English.


About the Company


  • My client is a $100m private investment fund that specialises in the medical aesthetics industry and has a network of warehouses globally that serve as local procurement centres which source and ship products to global customers
  • The customer tends to be small - medium size health care professionals such as cosmetic, plastic & derma surgeons as well as Aesthetics GPs.
  • In essence, my client is a B2B distributor of medical devices & medical aesthetics products like botox and derma fillers
  • They have a presence in over 13 countries and have the majority share of 15+ businesses that specialise in medical aesthetic (B2B) distribution - ecommerce (B2C) and on ground selling to clinics (B2B)


About the Need:


  • My client is looking for a consultant, or someone that they will work with on a contractual basis (you won't be an employee) who already has an existent business set up, in selling medical aesthetics (specifically dermal fillers and Botox injectables) into Health Care Practises / Beauty Salons / Clinics in Brazil.
  • They will be able to supply you with all the 3rd party sourced products (Botox and dermal fillers) and you will leverage your local network to help with the assortment, and you will use your own ground sales network to open up the Brazilian market for my client.
  • Brazil is a good market for this business, as is the wider LATAM region.
  • Maybe you own a beauty clinic, or chain of beauty clinics already in Brazil.
  • Maybe you used to work in Sales for the big global manufactures within medical aesthetics in Brazil and now you are on your own, working as a sales rep, and looking for new products to sell.
  • Maybe your run your own distribution business in Brazil and you have a huge network of beauty salons / clinics - that you already are selling too.
  • You must be fluent in English (written and verbal) to be relevant.


YOU MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE IN BRAZIL SELLING INTO BEAUTY CLINICS / AESTHETIC MEDICINE CLINICS for dermal fillers and injectables only (not prescription medicine).



Responsibilities

  • Someone who will head up the on ground wholesale sales into Brazil in partnership with the the fund - To be relevant for this, you will already either be doing this currently, or have done this very recently in your background
  • You will be selling medical aesthetics like dermal fillers, Botox, injectables directly to any kind of healthcare clinic that uses them. Therefore you MUST have previous experience in selling to small - medium size health care practises who stock similar products.
  • Previous experience in selling to beauty salons, cosmetic GPs and Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons, Aesthetics GPs is essential for success within this capacity
  • This person, or partner, or business, will own the wholesale distribution for the Brazilian market
  • You will leverage your network in Brazil, and detailed product expertise within medical aesthetics, to help determine the price for resale as well as the wider assortment of products needed within the market. Where are the gaps? What are the gaps? You will bring detail expertise to the table here

title: Risk & Audit Expert Talent
description:
Risk & Audit Expert Talent at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo - Brazil, hybrid, fulltime


people at the heart of everything we do

Working at Randstad is unlike working at any organization. Because at Randstad we put people at the heart of everything we do. This goes for our clients, our talent, our employees and society. We combine our passion for people with the power of today’s technologies. This helps us support people and organizations in realizing their true potential. We call this partner for talent..

Learn more about our mission, history and values on our website:


BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.


The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.


Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.


how you will contribute

You are part of the Business Risk & Audit Function (BR&AF) that covers all business operations related to Clients, Talents and our (shared) Back-, Mid- and Front offices, as well as our Accounting & Reporting and other specialist functions like HR.


With your risk & audit experience and expertise you enhance Randstad's in-control situation together with other team members. This by preparing and performing: risk assessments; internal control assessments; audits; and reviews, and compile reports on these activities that make an impact on management.


  • you provide management combined assurance, utilizing insights from enterprise risk management, internal control as well as internal audits that you lead and/or execute. Therewith you create momentum within the company to strengthen the risk-control position for our operational, shared services and accounting processes.
  • you maintain contact with local and international management, global and local process owners and collaborate closely with other involved stakeholders like other impacted functions within the group.
  • you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as: our Client delivery and Talent operations specialists; and HR, Tax, Accounting & Reporting and Planning & Control specialists.
  • you take ownership for the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.
  • you are willing to travel. As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.


what you will be doing

As an independent and objective risk & audit expert, you are going to:

  • participate and take the lead in risk assessments and audit planning and scoping, including researching relevant business objectives, policies, regulations.
  • prepare and execute audits by evaluating and analyzing the design and operating effectiveness of controls in mitigating identified risks.
  • execute audits and reviews for operational processes and controls, in areas such as: client delivery and Talent intake, as well as shared services operations and specialist functions like HR management, marketing & communication, finance, accounting & reporting, planning & control, non-financial reporting.
  • participate and lead audit interviews, be accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management, based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a recourse for colleagues with less expertise.


who will you work with

  • Business operations managers both working with our Clients and Talents, as well as shared services center managers and functional specialists in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Business operations and shared services process owners and control owners in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Tax and Legal counterparts (including legal compliance leads) both at corporate level as well as in our operating companies
  • MD BR&AF, other BR&AF leaders, team members and business partners
  • External co-source partners


what you will bring

Your risk & audit skills are well developed, as a critical challenger to process owners and business managers you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest and business acumen for Client delivery and Talent related operational processes as well as shared services organizations, how they serve internal customers and optimize their operations. You have a broad interest in specialist functions that support the overall governance of Randstad's international presence.

As an Internal Audit Expert you:

  • have minimum 8 years of relevant experience
  • have minimum master degree in business or economics and related accreditation (e.g. CPA/CA/CIA/ACCA)
  • have level BEC B1/B2 or higher Business English, preferably combined with proficiency in one of the following languages: Dutch, Spanish, French, Italian and /or German
  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo
  • have experience with excel in risk & audit methodologies & tools and internal control theories
  • have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job learning & development
  • have a proven track record in control design & implementation, risk based auditing and reporting.
  • are experienced in performing integrated audits working with changing teams
  • are specialized depth and breadth of expertise in business process risk analysis
  • have experience with data driven analysis


your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances
  • collaborates, reaches out, you excel in organizational sensitivity: maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization


what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad here .


If you recognize yourself in the profile above, we invite you to apply for this role. For more information you can reach out to our recruitment business partner:


The recruitment procedure consists of a screening and at least two interviews. Later in the process, an (online) assessment and a job offer conversation take place.

To apply, please submit your resume (CV) and a cover letter.

Acelere com a Gente: Junte-se a nós para transformar o cenário financeiro do mundo dos combustíveis, aproveitando cada oportunidade de crescimento e inovação!


Responsabilidades

  • Extração e Transformação de Dados (ETL/ELT): Apoiar na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados, garantindo a ingestão, transformação e carregamento de dados de diversas fontes para o Data Lake.
  • Modelagem e Organização de Dados: Colaborar na definição e implementação de modelos de dados eficiente, visando otimizar o armazenamento e a consulta.
  • Qualidade e Governança de Dados: Auxiliar na implementação de rotinas de validação e monitoramento da qualidade dos dados, contribuindo para a governança e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Criação de Dashboards e Relatórios: Desenvolver e manter painéis de dados e relatórios para diversas áreas de negócio, utilizando as informações centralizadas para gerar insights e apoiar a tomada de decisão.

  • Colaboração Interáreas: Atuar em parceria com equipes de negócio, tecnologia, produto e outras, garantindo o alinhamento na utilização dos dados do Data Lake e na entrega de valor.
  • Documentação e Melhoria Contínua: Participar da documentação de processos e estruturas de dados, e contribuir para a identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nas ferramentas e metodologias de dados.


Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com Python e SQL: Capacidade de manipular, consultar e processar dados eficientemente.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de Data Lake e Data Warehouses: Experiência em modelagem de dados e construção de pipelines de dados e processos de ETL/ELT.
  • Ferramentas de Visualização de Dados: Domínio em Power BI, incluindo Power Query, linguagem M e DAX. Experiência com outras ferramentas como Tableau e Looker Studio é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de Elaborar Consultas Complexas e Criar Visualizações Impactantes: Habilidade para produzir insights claros e valiosos a partir dos dados.

Diferenciais

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist  to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital


You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency. Your focus: deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.


Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know who  to contact, how , and when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years  of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of SQL , Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

    • What we offer

    Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

    But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

    • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
    • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
    • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
    • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
    • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência sólida em dados para atuar na otimização de pipelines, garantir a integridade da informação e apoiar a integração de novas fontes e tecnologias

Domínio em SQL

Python para manipulação, automação e integração de dados.

Spark para processamento de grandes volumes de dados.

Conhecimento em ETL/ELT e pipelines de dados.

Vivência com Cloud AWS (Glue, Redshift, Athena, S3, EMR).


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Coordenador Remuneração e Performance
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Tegra Incorporadora está em busca de um Coordenador de Remuneração e Performance , responsável por liderar a estratégia de remuneração e gestão de performance organizacional. Essa posição tem como foco, garantir o equilíbrio entre equidade interna, competitividade de mercado e alinhamento com os objetivos corporativos.


Entre suas responsabilidades estão a definição, gestão e governança das políticas de cargos e salários, remuneração variável e dos processos de desdobramento e acompanhamento de metas. Atuará como parceiro estratégico, apoiando decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas por meio de dados, análises e indicadores.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir o processo de cálculo e divulgação do programa de remuneração variável, garantindo transparência e alinhamento com as diretrizes da empresa;

  • Liderar o desenho, revisão e governança das políticas de remuneração fixa e variável (curto e longo prazo);
  • Garantir a manutenção e evolução da estrutura de cargos e salário;
  • Conduzir análises de competitividade externa e equidade interna, suportando decisões salariais e de movimentações;

  • Liderar a elaboração e consolidação de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais, incluindo Formulário de Referência da CVM, Relatório Integrado e indicadores da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimentos no processo de gestão de performance (Desdobramento e apuração de metas) será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em elaboração de relatórios regulatórios (ex: CVM), dashboards e KPIs;
  • Excel avançado e vivência com ferramentas de BI.

title: Senior Strategy Research Associate
description:
About Keeta


Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!



Know more: Keeta Website


About the Job


Senior Strategy Research Associate


Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP


Job Responsibilities：


1. Study the business segments, geographical layout, financial strength, and strategic play of the world's leading food delivery players, form a clear judgment on the global food delivery industry landscape and competitive situation, and propose effective development strategies and competitive strategies based on this judgment to support Keeta management's major decisions on resource allocation, organizational structure, capital operation, etc.


2. Participate in desk research, field research, and strategy formulation for Keeta's expansion into new countries, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation path of the company's strategic expansion into new regions, and combine facts and analysis to provide objective judgments on the industry, competition, and operational difficulties in specific countries to assist Keeta management in making decisions;


3. description:

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we help people be their best in the moments that matter. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. Our work is very meaningful, impactful, and cutting edge and we invite you to explore it. We are the Best!


Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of mission critical digital mobile communication systems for Government & Public Safety Communications customers.


Join to the team providing Solution Architecture for Unified Communications customers for EMEA/APAC/LATAM regions.


Job Description

Join a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of mission-critical communications. We are responsible for delivering advanced Push-to-Talk (PTT) solutions over broadband with seamless interoperability to Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems. As a Network and Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining the core infrastructure that powers our services.

The ideal candidate is a skilled and proactive individual with a strong background in IP networking, a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, and an interest in cybersecurity. In addition to core engineering duties, you will take ownership of hardware ordering and security vulnerability management, making this a pivotal role within the team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain robust IP network infrastructure, including switches and firewalls.
  • Manage and support virtualization and containerized environments, with a focus on cloud-native platforms like OpenShift and Podman.
  • Lead the hardware ordering process for the team, utilizing the Motorola CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) system.
  • Monitor and manage security-related issues, including vulnerability management for customer-facing solutions.
  • Ensure the reliable and secure interoperability between broadband PTT solutions and Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and contribute to solution architecture.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering
  • In-depth knowledge of IP networking principles and practical experience with switches and firewalls.
  • Demonstrated experience with virtualization technologies and container platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, such as OpenShift or Podman.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to system maintenance and security.


Preferred Skills & Qualifications (A Plus)

Certifications:

  • CompTIA Network+, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Security+
  • CCNA or CCNP
  • Juniper, FortiGate, or Extreme Networks certifications


Engineering Expertise:

  • Experience with datacenter engineering, including server connectivity (Ethernet vs. fiber) and adapters.
  • A strong interest or background in cybersecurity.


Relevant Experience:

  • Previous experience with Push-to-Talk (PTT) over broadband or Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware ordering processes and CPQ systems.

Especialista Funcional Oracle Cloud – A2C (Finanças)


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar no suporte e operação dos módulos de contas a receber e cobrança do Oracle ERP Cloud. Você fará parte de um time global, garantindo a entrega de serviços com excelência, conformidade SOX e aderência aos padrões ITIL.


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar nos módulos: Contas a Receber (Receivables), Clientes, Faturamento e Pagamentos, Cobrança
  • Resolver chamados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos (SLA), em parceria com fornecedores e equipes internas
  • Apoiar usuários durante o fechamento contábil mensal em regiões como LATAM, EUA e APAC
  • Realizar testes de regressão nas atualizações trimestrais do ambiente Oracle SaaS
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos SOX e manter documentação alinhada ao ITIL
  • Conduzir operações de suporte com foco em qualidade, comunicação e melhoria contínua
  • Implementar boas práticas usando ferramentas como ServiceNow e GitLab
  • Interagir com equipes de engenharia da Oracle e outras áreas de entrega para garantir integrações eficazes


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Experiência funcional em Oracle ERP Cloud: Receivíveis, Clientes, Cobrança e Faturamento
  • Conhecimento em captura de documentos fiscais e integração com Syncro ou EDICOM
  • Entendimento da tributação brasileira aplicada a faturamento e contas a receber
  • Vivência com localizações Oracle para o Brasil (LACLS) e geração de relatórios
  • Domínio de ferramentas como BIP, PL/SQL, Web Services (SOAP e REST), FBDI, ADFDi
  • Graduação em Contabilidade, Finanças, TI ou área relacionada
  • Fluência obrigatória em inglês.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
The Customer Support Representative plays a key role in ensuring a seamless and positive experience for users of the company’s sports betting and casino platform. This position requires strong communication skills, empathy, and problem-solving ability to resolve customer inquiries efficiently. Working on a 24/7 rotating roster, the role supports players in both Portuguese and English, providing professional service and contributing to the continuous improvement of the customer experience.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via live chat.
  • Resolve issues and complaints, offering appropriate solutions and following up to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Communicate fluently in both Portuguese and English to assist a diverse customer base.
  • Maintain accurate customer records and liaise with internal teams when escalation is needed.
  • Stay up-todate with company products, promotions, and policies to provide accurate information.
  • Provide feedback and suggestions to improve processes and enhance customer experience.
  • Collaborate with other operational teams to ensure customer needs are met.


Work Experience and Skills:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Prior experience in a customer service role (online, phone-based, or face-to-face).
  • Availability to work Monday to Friday
  • Ability to remain calm and efficient in a fast-paced environment.


Desirable Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with the crypto and online betting industry.
  • Previous experience in sports betting or online casino.
  • Experience working with tools such as Slack and G-Suite.


Personal Qualities and Behavioural Traits:

  • Strong customer focus with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to multitask and handle multiple inquiries simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently without close supervision.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and resilience under pressure.
  • Strong initiative and proactive approach to improving customer experience.
  • Collaborative team player, willing to share knowledge and support colleagues.


The Customer Support Representative will work closely with:

  • Team Leads and Senior Support staff.
  • Payments providers and the internal payments coordination team.
  • Other operational departments such as KYC, Marketing, Affiliates, Tech Support, and VIP.

title: Logistics Manager (Ecommerce Last Mile ）
description:
Job Responsibilities


  • Last Mile Operations Management: Oversee last mile logistics, ensuring timely and cost-efficient parcel distribution through partner carriers. Monitor daily operations, investigate anomalies, and implement corrective actions to maintain service excellence.
  • Performance Management: Define and track KPIs such as on-time delivery, delivery success rate, and transit times. Develop dashboards and reports to provide data-driven insights to internal stakeholders and senior management.
  • Supplier Coordination: Manage relationships with last mile carriers, ensuring service levels meet company standards. Conduct regular meetings, align volume forecasts, and monitor SLAs to maintain high performance.
  • Operational Standardization: Establish and document best practices for last mile logistics. Define roles, responsibilities, and performance management models to ensure consistency across operations.
  • Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements in delivery operations. Benchmark industry best practices and develop initiatives to enhance efficiency, capacity, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Lead proactive issue resolution, ensuring smooth communication between teams and timely escalation of critical cases. Implement feedback loops to drive continuous operational improvements.
  • Strategic Network Planning: Support the development of last mile network strategies, aligning logistics infrastructure with business growth plans and cost optimization goals.


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in last mile logistics operations, preferably in e-commerce and/or express logistics.
  • Operational Expertise: Strong understanding of last mile logistics, carrier coordination, and performance management.
  • Experience with Next-Day and Second-Day Delivery: Knowledge of express delivery models and their operational challenges.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to analyze KPIs, identify risks, and drive process improvements through data insights.
  • Hands-on Approach: Willingness to visit field operations, engage with carriers, and ensure seamless execution.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Quick analytical thinking to address operational challenges and implement preventive measures.
  • Project Management: Experience in leading and executing logistics projects, working cross-functionally to achieve business goals.
  • Mandatory fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish and Mandarin are a plus.

title: Keeta Technology - Software Engineer
description:
The position is responsible for the development and optimization of core modules, guiding team growth. Requires over 3 years of experience and proficiency in Java and mainstream development frameworks.


Job Responsibilities


1. Lead the architectural design and medium-to-long-term technical planning for Meituan Keeta's core business systems, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals.


2. Participate in system design and development of core modules for projects, ensuring on-time delivery.


3. Resolve critical issues and technical challenges in projects, continuously optimize architectures, and provide reasonable solutions and recommendations for complex business models.


4. Mentor and train junior engineers to enhance the team’s overall business and technical capabilities.


Basic Requirements


1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or related fields, with at least 3 years of system development experience.


2. Proficient in Java and object-oriented design/development; preference for candidates with experience analyzing source code of high-quality open-source software.


3. Familiar with common design patterns; proficient in mainstream frameworks such as Springboot, SpringCloud, Mybatis, and Thrift.


4. Skilled in MySQL application development, database principles, and common performance optimization/scaling techniques; knowledge of common NoSQL databases and their use cases.


5. High sense of responsibility and dedication, capable of solving technical challenges while proactively focusing on business needs to drive innovation through technology.


Preferred Qualifications


1. Knowledge in areas such as shopping guide ,transactions, orders, marketing growth, delivery fulfillment, CRM, merchant supply, etc., with internet industry experience (e.g., e-commerce, O2O business systems).


2. Participation or leadership in designing and developing large-scale complex distributed internet business systems, with experience in high-concurrency architecture design and stability assurance.

title: Analista de Planejamento de Vendas Sr

Visão analítica e foco em resultado

Capacidade de traduzir dados em ações práticas

Domínio de Excel

Conhecimento em SQL e manipulação de bases de dados

title: Data Analyst (Azure)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related field.

title: Estagiário de Gestão de Projetos
description:
Objetivo da Posição

Dar suporte a gestão no acompanhamento de projetos, garantindo organização, controle e comunicação eficaz entre as diversas áreas envolvidas, de forma a assegurar que prazos e entregas sejam cumpridos.


Principais Atividades

  • Apoiar no acompanhamento do cronograma do projeto, registrando avanços, riscos e pontos de atenção;
  • Consolidar e atualizar relatórios de status do projeto, garantindo informações claras e objetivas para os gestores;
  • Fazer interface com diferentes áreas da empresa, coletando informações, acompanhando entregas e reforçando prazos;
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento, elaborando atas, registrando decisões e acompanhando follow-ups;
  • Apoiar na identificação de riscos e oportunidades relacionados à execução do projeto;
  • Manter a organização da documentação do projeto (cronogramas, relatórios, atas, dashboards etc.);
  • Auxiliar na preparação de apresentações executivas e materiais de comunicação do projeto;
  • Atualizar e acompanhar orçamento do projeto.


Requisitos indispensáveis

  • Formação: Estudante de Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 3º semestre);
  • Idioma: Inglês nível avançado;
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes: Capacidade de gerenciar diversas informações sem perder prazos ou prioridades;
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva: Facilidade de interação com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Proatividade e autonomia: Iniciativa para buscar informações, cobrar entregas e propor soluções;
  • Capacidade analítica: Organização de dados e indicadores de forma estruturada para apoiar tomadas de decisão;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis: Pacote Office (principalmente Excel e PowerPoint) e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: MS Project, Trello, Monday ou similares);
  • Habilidade em trabalho em equipe: Boa relação interpessoal e disposição para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico.


Benefícios

  • Auxílio transporte
  • Estacionamento gratuito
  • Restaurante no local (duas refeições por dia)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • TotalPass
  • Vale Alimentação

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Business Introduction

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Gerente de SecOps
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Gerente de SecOps



Resumo:

O Gerente de SecOps é responsável pela estratégia e entrega do dia a dia de Security Operations através da companhia, incluindo SOC (Security Operations Center), Gestão de Vulnerabilidades, Pentesting e Gestão de Identidades. Esta posição, com reporte ao Diretor de Cyber Security, desempenhará um papel fundamental no fortalecimento da postura de segurança da empresa, liderando uma equipe de profissionais de segurança e garantindo que o ambiente seja continuamente monitorado e protegido.



O que você irá fazer:

  • Estratégia de SecOps: liderar a estratégia de Security Operations do ponto de vista de pessoas, processos e ferramentas, desenhando modelos de operação técnica e documentações, gerenciando ferramentas de segurança e KPIs de processos, orçamento e riscos com recursos internos e externos.
  • Liderança do SOC: liderar e supervisionar as operações 24/7 do SOC, incluindo monitoramento, detecção, resposta a incidentes e inteligência de ameaças.
  • Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: liderar o programa de gestão de vulnerabilidades da empresa, garantindo a identificação, relatório, priorização e remediação de riscos de forma eficaz para ativos de infraestrutura e código seguro.
  • Pentesting: liderar atividades e exercícios de pentest/red team internos e externos com aplicações de negócios e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de Identidade e Acesso: liderar o programa de IAM incluindo governança, provisionamento, gerenciamento de acesso privilegiado e controles de acesso baseados em funções.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: gerenciar, orientar e desenvolver uma equipe de coordenadores, engenheiros e analistas de segurança.




O que buscamos?

  • Sólida experiência em operações de cibersegurança e em funções de gestão ou liderança.
  • Excelente conhecimento e experiência prática com implementação, implantação e operações de ferramentas de segurança, incluindo SIEM/SOAR (por exemplo, Sentinel, Chronicle, Splunk), EDR/XDR (Crowdstrike, Defender, SentinelOne, etc.), scan de vulnerabilidades (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, etc.), SAST/DAST/SCA (Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk), frameworks de pentesting e red team (Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Caldera, etc.) e IAM (Azure AD, Okta, CyberArk, etc.).
  • Sólida compreensão de segurança em nuvem (Azure, GCP, AWS).
  • Ótimo conhecimento de frameworks de segurança (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, etc.).
  • Ótimas habilidades analíticas e de relatórios para apoiar a entrega de KPIs.
  • Experiência em gerenciar múltiplos fornecedores e entrega de serviços globais.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão.
  • Forte conhecimento prático das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fluente em inglês.



Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:




  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua




Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!




Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Corporate Communications Specialist
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 27 years.

We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world.


Today our team has more than 5 000 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.

Together we protect the world from cyber threats.


Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving!


As part of the Americas Corporate Communications team, you’ll manage daily PR and social media routines, such as creating content, mapping journalists and influencers, tracking performance, and supporting integrated campaigns.


You’ll also collaborate with marketing and sales (B2B & B2C) and contribute to global initiatives adapted for Brazil.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Content Development

  • Write and review PR materials: press releases, articles, presentations, official statements, FAQs, and fact sheets.
  • Create and adapt content for social media: scripts, copy for visual assets, and digital campaign materials.
  • Draft executive bios and corporate documents (including content for corporate websites and internal portals).
  • Copyedit, proofread, and adapt communications, reports, and translations.
  • Produce and customize media pitches in English and Portuguese.
  • Translate communication materials into English or Portuguese when needed (we work with a translation provider).

2. Strategy and Planning

  • Support the planning, development, and execution of product communication campaigns and corporate projects, integrating traditional and digital channels to promote the company’s brand, products, technologies, and positioning.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and expert teams to ensure alignment of messaging and initiatives.
  • Work closely with global corporate communications teams to support media requests, as well as implement global campaigns and projects in the local market.
  • Oversee and coordinate the production of PR and social media materials developed by external agencies and vendors.
  • Contribute ideas and participate in brainstorming for campaigns, events, and special initiatives.

3. Operations and Reporting

  • Manage social media promotion: launching, monitoring, and optimizing campaigns.
  • Support the organization and execution of PR and social media events.
  • Map journalists, influencers, and monitor industry trends.
  • Track media coverage and analyze PR and social media performance metrics.
  • Consolidate and review reports provided by PR and social media agencies across the Americas region – and prepare social media reports as needed.
  • Prepare analyses on the effectiveness of departmental activities and campaigns.
  • Provide support for media outreach and stakeholder engagement when needed.
  • Organize agendas, schedules, and administrative routines related to events and projects.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in PR or Social Media (minimum of 2 years). Experience in both areas is a plus but not mandatory. Writing/journalism experience is also valued.
  • Excellent writing skills and ability to adapt language for different channels (press, social media, corporate) in Portuguese and English .
  • Desirable understanding of the technology market ; strong interest in learning about cybersecurity, innovation, and technology is mandatory.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to supervise partners/agencies, and meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivated individual with the ability to work both in teams and independently.
  • Resourceful, solution-oriented, and able to handle unexpected situations.
  • Must be able to see all assigned tasks through from beginning to end.
  • Fluent English (for interaction with regional and global teams). Spanish is also a plus.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and results-oriented profile.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

Why Join Coty?

If you are passionate about talent, diversity, and regional impact , this opportunity is for you.

Apply now and be part of our journey!

title: Channel Business Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
You will center your role on relationship management to achieve measurable results in increased revenue, market share, and depth within each partner sales team at the assigned Partner Accounts. Your success in this role will span the creation and execution of unique business plans with each potential partner. You’ll be measured primarily on the joint business executed with these strategic partners at an international level, working at the heart of the VAR, GSI & MSSP account teams. You will be collaborating with a variety of internal stakeholders including Global / International Account Directors.
Your focus will be to drive enhanced alignment between the sales teams at PAN+Partners, as well as driving execution with excellence across account planning and pipeline management on all joint opportunities.
Your Impact
  • Develop and execute business plans in collaboration with the Account Directors, driving all aspects of the partner relationship to maximize growth opportunities and ensuring the partner is well-positioned to deliver successful customer implementations and deployments
  • Work well in a team environment to ensure partner and customer satisfaction
  • Design a compelling value proposition that inspires this strategic partner to promote our solutions
  • Develop/activate services based on our emerging and established technologies increasing revenue growth, and liaise closely with our product teams to innovate new solutions and GTM strategies to drive new ways to differentiate in the market and take market share (drive scale)
  • Provide clear and consistent communication (internally and externally) across the region with partners to build strong partnerships throughout your assignment
  • Lead regular business performance and relationship reviews with senior management and various stakeholders
  • Build and maintain the activity of performance reports and activity dashboards
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Channel Management, or Business Development roles within the enterprise software ecosystem and/or network security industry
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish languages
  • Understanding of the local MCA market
  • Understanding of SP & GSI operating models is nice to have
  • Knowledge of sales, marketing, and solution development
  • Demonstrate strong initiative and ability to think creatively with excellent presentation, written, and overall communication skills
  • Consistent track record of leading complex sales situations through negotiation and conflict resolution
Additional Information
The Team
The channel organization at Palo Alto Networks is a strategic pillar for our continued growth within cybersecurity, and a critical component to accomplishing our mission. Channel development is an extension of the territory sales team, with the ultimate goal to train and enable our channel partners to become empowered in the use and sales of our products.
Compensation Disclosure
The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/commissioned roles) is expected to be between $ /YR - $ /YR. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here .
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Desenvolvedor Unity Sênior
description:
Por que se juntar a nós


A Hypesoft é uma consultoria global de software que preza pela excelência técnica e inovação tecnológica. Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a alcançar o sucesso por meio de soluções customizadas e tecnologias de ponta. Atendemos desde startups em crescimento até grandes corporações, entregando qualidade e eficiência em escala global.


Trabalhar na Hypesoft significa ultrapassar limites, desafiar o status quo e colaborar com algumas das mentes mais brilhantes da indústria. Aqui, seu potencial só será limitado pelo tamanho dos seus sonhos. Acreditamos no protagonismo e na construção de uma cultura que valoriza a inovação e o crescimento contínuo, e tornamos isso realidade ao fornecer as ferramentas e o suporte que você precisa para desenvolver sua carreira.




Engenharia na Hypesoft


O time de Engenharia da Hypesoft é composto por áreas como Dados, Infraestrutura, Segurança e Software, e é responsável por construir soluções tecnológicas inovadoras para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos em equipes autônomas e colaborativas, que estão sempre prontas para aprender, compartilhar e melhorar continuamente. Nosso objetivo é construir sistemas robustos e escaláveis que permitam o rápido crescimento da Hypesoft e ajudem nossos clientes a alcançar seu máximo potencial.



O que você fará


Como Desenvolvedor Unity na Hypesoft , você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e otimizar experiências interativas de alto impacto, desde jogos complexos até soluções imersivas para diferentes indústrias. Terá a oportunidade de aplicar algoritmos avançados para resolver problemas de performance, IA, física e renderização, elevando a qualidade técnica e a inovação dos produtos que entregamos.


Buscamos profissionais com forte base em algoritmos, estruturas de dados e resolução de problemas (nível LeetCode/HackerRank hard), capazes de lidar com desafios técnicos de alta complexidade. Você será incentivado a liderar projetos técnicos, propor soluções inovadoras e criar arquiteturas escaláveis que suportem milhões de usuários.




Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e otimizar aplicações e jogos em Unity de alto desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Criar algoritmos eficientes para IA, física, pathfinding, geração procedural e renderização.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (arte, design, produto) para transformar conceitos em experiências técnicas sólidas.
  • Analisar problemas complexos e propor soluções técnicas elegantes, considerando performance e qualidade da experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento: design, implementação, testes e operação em produção.
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia, mantendo a consistência e a qualidade do código.
  • Contribuir ativamente para decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas em projetos de grande impacto.
  • Prototipar rapidamente ideias e validar hipóteses técnicas.



Requisitos


  • 5+ anos de experiência com Unity (C#) no desenvolvimento de jogos em produção.
  • Domínio de algoritmos e estruturas de dados (nível competitivo / LeetCode Hard / HackerRank).
  • Experiência em otimização de performance (CPU, GPU, memória, garbage collection, batching, LOD).
  • Sólido conhecimento em arquitetura de software , padrões de design e princípios de engenharia (SOLID, Clean Code, Clean Architecture).
  • Experiência com render pipelines (URP/HDRP) e programação de shaders.
  • Experiência com sistemas multiplayer e rede (Photon, Mirror, Netcode for GameObjects ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em motores de física, AI e pathfinding (NavMesh, A*, comportamento de agentes).
  • Experiência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de QA em projetos Unity.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas técnicos complexos de forma independente e colaborativa.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em desafios de programação competitiva (ICPC, Codeforces, LeetCode Contest).
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning aplicado a jogos/IA .
  • Experiência com realidade aumentada (ARKit/ARCore) ou realidade virtual (Oculus/SteamVR) .
  • Contribuições open-source em projetos Unity ou bibliotecas de algoritmos.
  • Publicação de jogos ou soluções imersivas de grande escala.
